issues.problem: The fetched excerpts are only the RFC index page, so the section text is not visible. The RFC wording used in the explanation (the 415 format cause, the Accept response header hint, the 406 proactive negotiation headers, the 422 'unable to process the contained instructions') matches my knowledge of RFC 9110. The Azure api-design excerpt directly supports the 415/406 split.
